ABOUT THE BAR

Built for hosts who don't want to think about the bar.

Kwatro Kantos Mobile Bar was established in 2024 to bring a proper, full-service cocktail bar to events across Metro Manila, without the client needing to rent a venue with a bar already built in.

We show up with our own setup, our own bartenders, and a menu built around classic cocktails and signature mixes, so hosts can hand off one more thing and focus on their guests.

We've poured for weddings, corporate functions, and private parties, and we've exhibited at industry events like the Toast Wedding Fair at the World Trade Center Metro Manila.

Full Setup BAR, TOOLS & GLASSWARE
Trained Staff PROFESSIONAL BARTENDERS
Custom Menus BUILT AROUND YOUR EVENT
WHAT WE POUR

The bar menu

Every booking is built around a menu suited to the event. From an easy beer-and-highball setup to a full cocktail program with a champagne finish.

Signature Cocktails

Kwatro Kantos originals. Lemongrass Mojito and Spicy Mango Tequila. House creations that guests won't find anywhere else.

EXCLUSIVELY OURS

Everyday Cocktails

Whiskey Sour, Screwdriver, Daiquiri, Tequila Sunrise, Margarita. The crowd-pleasers done right, every time.

CROWD FAVORITES

Classic Cocktails

Everything in Everyday, plus Classic Mojito, Old Fashioned, Amaretto Sour, Gin Tonic, Pina Colada, and Cosmopolitan.

THE FULL LIST

Wine Cocktails

Red Sangria and White Sangria. Included in all packages as a refined option alongside the main cocktail menu.

INCLUDED IN ALL PACKAGES

Boondocks Craft Beer

Summer Ale, Wheat Ale, Session Ale, and Strong Ale. Locally brewed, event-ready. Included in Package 4 or available as an add-on.

CRAFT ADD-ON

Champagne Tower

A centerpiece pour for the toast. A cascading champagne tower built and poured on site for the photo-worthy moment.

BEFORE YOU BOOK

Other booking details

A few things to know so your event day runs without surprises.

CREW MEALS
2 meals per staff (dinner and midnight snack) for bartenders and the sales representative. If the client is unable to provide crew meals, a meal allowance of PHP 400 per staff will be requested.
ELECTRICAL PROVISION
1,000 watts with 3 outlets to be provided by the venue.
BOTTLE SERVICE FEE
PHP 150 per bottle of hard liquor (750ml to 1.5 liters) brought in by the client.
OVERTIME FEES
PHP 1,000 per hour charged to the client for bar service exceeding the standard 5-hour window.
OUT OF TOWN FEES
Transportation fee based on 3rd party transport service and toll fees. Total charges will be billed on the day of the event.

Have questions about any of these before committing? Reach out and we will walk you through everything.
